muteByDefault.name: Mute everyone by default
muteByDefault.description: Players you have not unmuted start muted. Turning this off immediately unmutes everyone this addon muted, on every server, and cannot be undone. Your own manual mutes are kept.

exemptFriends.name: Always hear friends
exemptFriends.description: People on your LabyMod friends list are never muted automatically.

rememberUnmuted.name: Remember who I unmute
rememberUnmuted.description: Once you unmute somebody they stay audible in future sessions. Turn this off to have unmutes last only until you quit.

microphoneGuard.name: Auto mute microphone
microphoneGuard.description: Switches your own microphone off while someone you cannot hear is close enough to hear you. So whenever this is active nobody hears you, friends included.

guardRadius.name: Distance that counts as earshot
guardRadius.description: How close a muted player has to be, in blocks, before your microphone is cut. 24 matches the range at which proximity voice actually carries. People sharing a voice channel with you always count, however far away they are, because channel audio ignores distance.

command.hint: Click a name to mute or unmute them.
command.allHintAfter: to see everyone you muted or unmuted.
command.nearbyHintAfter: to see who is in voice range now.
